responsibility: Declares the exported interface of the AVR backend for use across generated machine-description code, target headers, and companion source files. It centralizes prototypes for target hooks, RTL output helpers, address-space and section logic, prologue/epilogue emitters, predicates used outside `.md` files, custom passes, wide/fixed-point support routines, and the AVR logging API, and it also publishes backend globals such as special hard-register RTX objects and the `avr_have_dimode` capability flag.
